neighbours.label: the digit 9 or 4 as the decade (third) digit of a four-digit year, strongest for 1700s-1800s years (1794, 1849, 1895, also 1946, 1993), or as the first digit of a phone exchange ((518) 956-, 301-402-); the same year with another decade digit (1857, 1762, 1983) stays quiet; weaker on 9 or 4 elsewhere in numbers and on the spelled word 'Nine'
neighbours.short: decade digit 9 or 4 in a year, or phone exchange starting 9/4
fire: The treaty was signed in the autumn of 1794 after months of talks.
Thousands of prospectors rushed west in 1849 hoping to strike gold.
By 1895 the town had its first electric streetlights.
The war in Europe ended in the spring of 1945.
She graduated from college in 1993 with a degree in chemistry.
Records from 1742 show the church was rebuilt after a fire.
For reservations, call the inn at (518) 956-2210 before noon.
quiet: Toward the close of the nineteenth century, bicycles swept the cities.
Nine cats and four dogs lived on that farm.
The treaty was signed in the autumn of 1774 after months of talks.

By 1885 the town had its first gas streetlights.
